channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: The winning recipes for the 2025 Minnesota Star Tribune Holiday Cookie Contest
item.description: Sweet and salty, chocolate and caramel, nutty and minty — this year’s winning batch of cookies has it all.

item.title: J.J. McCarthy’s ‘mentality has changed’ as the Vikings quarterback tries to let loose
item.description: McCarthy, a self-described overthinker and perfectionist, said the coaching staff’s recent shift from his mechanics to his decision making frees up “a lot of space mentally.”

item.title: Lutsen Resort owner charged with arson, insurance fraud in North Shore resort fire
item.description: The 2024 blaze destroyed the historic lodge in the middle of a February night, when no guests were booked.

item.title: Snow returns Friday, Saturday in the Twin Cities and southern Minnesota
item.description: Friday’s morning commute and weekend travel could be impacted by the snow.

item.title: Takeaways: Timberwolves do enough to make it a sweep of Pelicans
item.description: The Wolves again made life tough on themselves vs. the worst team in the West, but they left New Orleans with two victories in two games.

item.title: Twin Cities districts vow to block ICE access to schools amid reports of agents near campuses
item.description: School districts are increasing security and pledge to deny federal agents entry without a judge’s order.

item.title: ICE announces a dozen Minneapolis arrests in ‘Operation Metro Surge’
item.description: The men arrested are from Mexico, Somalia and El Salvador.

item.title: Twin Cities religious leaders unite to support Somali community and condemn Trump attacks
item.description: Religious leaders from churches, Jewish temples and mosques from across the state opposed remarks from President Donald Trump that included calling Somalis “garbage.”
